name: Sussex
summary: A PDO covering East and West Sussex, crossed by the chalk of the South Downs. Traditional method sparkling wine from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier is the main style, and still wines are made too.
label_note: Labels must carry "protected designation of origin" and "Product of England" or "Made in England". "Sussex" may be followed by "Classic" or "Origin", and for sparkling wine by "Sparkling".

grapes.name: Meunier
grapes.local_note: Listed as Pinot Meunier in the Sussex specification.

appellations.name: Sussex
appellations.note: PDO for traditional method sparkling and still wine grown and made in East and West Sussex. Sparkling wine spends at least 15 months in bottle before release.

appellations.name: English
appellations.note: Country-wide PDO for wine from vines in England grown below 220 metres.

appellations.name: English Regional
appellations.note: Country-wide PGI for regional wine from England.

name: Kakheti
summary: Georgia's largest wine region, in the east of the country, makes most of its wine. Saperavi leads the reds and Rkatsiteli the whites, many of them fermented on their skins in clay qvevri as amber wines.
label_note: The label shows "KAKHETI" with "Protected Designation of Origin" or "PDO". The wine must be made inside Kakheti; bottling may take place elsewhere in Georgia.

grapes.name: Rkatsiteli
grapes.local_note: Made as a dry white or as an amber wine on its skins.

grapes.name: Saperavi
grapes.local_note: The only grape of Mukuzani, Kvareli and Akhasheni.

grapes.name: Mtsvane Kakhuri
grapes.local_note: Called Kakhuri Mtsvane in the appellation rules; often up to 15% beside Rkatsiteli.

grapes.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
grapes.local_note: Allowed for red and rosé Kakheti; the only grape of Teliani.

appellations.name: Kakheti
appellations.note: Region-wide appellation for the eight Kakheti municipalities: white, amber, red and rosé, dry to sweet.

appellations.name: Tsinandali
appellations.note: Dry white from Rkatsiteli with up to 15% Mtsvane Kakhuri, or dry red from Saperavi.

appellations.name: Mukuzani
appellations.note: Dry red from Saperavi only, on the right bank of the Alazani.

appellations.name: Napareuli
appellations.note: Dry red from Saperavi, or dry white from Rkatsiteli with up to 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane; Telavi municipality.

appellations.name: Kindzmarauli
appellations.note: Naturally semi-sweet red from Saperavi, in Kvareli municipality.

appellations.name: Kvareli
appellations.note: Dry red from Saperavi.

appellations.name: Akhasheni
appellations.note: Semi-sweet red from Saperavi.

appellations.name: Teliani
appellations.note: Dry red from Cabernet Sauvignon only.

appellations.name: Gurjaani
appellations.note: Dry white from Rkatsiteli, with about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane allowed.

appellations.name: Vazisubani
appellations.note: Dry white from Rkatsiteli, with about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane allowed.

appellations.name: Manavi
appellations.note: Dry white from Kakhuri Mtsvane only, in Sagarejo municipality.

appellations.name: Tibaani
appellations.note: Dry amber wine from Rkatsiteli, with about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane and Khikhvi allowed.

appellations.name: Kardenakhi
appellations.note: Dry amber wine or fortified white from Rkatsiteli, with about 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane and Khikhvi allowed.

appellations.name: Kotekhi
appellations.note: Dry white from Rkatsiteli or dry red from Saperavi, on the right bank of the Alazani.

appellations.name: Saperavi Khashmi
appellations.note: Dry red from Saperavi grown around the village of Khashmi, Sagarejo municipality.

appellations.name: Tsarapi
appellations.note: Dry amber wine from Rkatsiteli, with up to 15% Kakhuri Mtsvane and Khikhvi; village of Kardenakhi.

appellations.name: Akhmeta
appellations.note: White or amber wine from Kakhuri Mtsvane in Akhmeta municipality; also sold as Akhmetis Mtsvane.

appellations.name: Akhoebi
appellations.note: Dry red from Saperavi and Saperavi Budeshuri; village of Kardenakhi.

appellations.name: Kisi Magraani
appellations.note: Dry white or amber wine from Kisi, in Akhmeta municipality.

appellations.name: Zegaani
appellations.note: Dry red from Saperavi made in qvevri.
